examples.question_text: Draw a timeline from $1820$ to $1940$ using six equal spaces. Find the years represented by each space, label every tick and mark an event from $1870$.
A timeline uses $5$ years per space. How many spaces separate events from $1992$ and $2022$?

examples.derivation: The scale is 10 years per 12.5 mm. Therefore 1980 and 2000 lie at 12.5 mm and 37.5 mm. Their gap is 2000−1980=20 years.

The supplied Stage 3 Data A syllabus supports drawing timelines with an appropriate scale; Data B supports interpreting timelines using that scale. Each decade occupies 16.6666666667 mm. Extending the original ticks at 0, 16.6666666667, 33.3333333333 and 50 mm places 2020 at 66.6666666667 mm. The events remain correctly positioned at 1990, 2010 and 2020. Their consecutive gaps are 2010−1990=20 years and 2020−2010=10 years, so the largest gap is 20 years, between opening and adding the pond. Removing the unsupported style special and changing bounding space, arrow extent and label anchors preserves these relationships. Endpoint year labels face inward; Greenhouse is above Pond with its leader attached to the correct event.
1965 is halfway between 1960 and 1970, at approximately 8.3333 mm. 1985 is halfway between 1980 and 1990, at approximately 41.6667 mm. The gap is 1985−1965=20 years.
Each 20-year interval occupies 10 mm. Each event is 15 years, or three quarters of an interval, after its preceding tick. Positions are 7.5, 27.5 and 47.5 mm. The overall span is 1895−1815=80 years.
1940−1820=120 years; 120÷6=20 years per space. Seven ticks correctly read 1820, 1840, 1860, 1880, 1900, 1920 and 1940. The year 1870 lies halfway between 1860 and 1880, at approximately 20.8333 mm.
2022−1992=30 years; 30÷5=6 spaces. The diagram has seven equally spaced ticks forming six intervals, with the events correctly marked at its endpoints.
